# brig sandbox detach

Detach a provider from a sandbox

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox detach [VM] SANDBOX PROVIDER
```

## Description

Detach a provider from a ready sandbox and wait until the sandbox applies
it, as openshell sandbox provider detach --wait does. The rules that the
provider added to the sandbox's policy go with it; programs that run already
keep its placeholders until they restart.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
